payload.title: Typed knowledge extraction and weekly trends for publication knowledge bases
payload.description:
Biblicus-side work needed so a publication can show entity pages, typed relations and weekly trends from its corpus. First consumer: the Shipped publication (AnthusAI/Shipped-web, board key SHIP). Papyrus consumers: initiative PPY-428252 (Public knowledge base: expose the wiki, topics and trends in publications) and initiative PPY-77bb3b (collaborative steering).

Scope boundary (see AGENTS.md): Biblicus produces extracted text, analysis outputs and proposals. Editorial acceptance, publishing and the public surface belong to Papyrus; learned decisions belong to Cyclotron.

Children (all stories):
1. Weekly time-series bins for topic-trends.
2. Cluster identity across runs (new, merged, split clusters).
3. Typed-entity extractor with closed vocabularies, typed relations and entity resolution.
4. Exploration: decision-model-based extractors versus the current spaCy pipeline.
5. Pending: cloud job runner for topic modelling and extraction jobs.

Definition of Done: each child closed or explicitly deferred; Papyrus board items cross-linked by full id.
